search_space: All 2028 tuples (r,ρ_k,x,y) with r in {1,2,3}, ρ_k in {0,1,2,3}, and x,y in {-6,-5,...,6}, checked in lexicographic loop order. Circle membership and failure of |u|=r are tested exactly using integer squared distances.
witness_description: Take r=1, ρ_k=1, and u=-2+0i. The circle is centered at -1, and u lies on it because |u-(-1)|=|-1|=1.
refutation_explanation: For this point, |u|=2, so ln|u|=ln 2, whereas ln r=ln 1=0. Since 2≠1 and the natural logarithm is injective on positive numbers, these values are unequal.
